resourceListPageBlock.title: MCP Resource List Page
resourceListPageBlock.description: A Sidebar workspace that follows the Zentirx MCP management design with application and category tabs.
resourceListPageBlock.guidanceBody: Use controlled mode in production and relate MCPs to categories through a stable categoryId. Server-paginated integrations use remote category mode with authoritative counts, detail loading, retry, permissions, and asynchronous removal. Category management reuses Zeron PageColumns, PageAside, and MobileDrawer for the same responsive right-detail layout as the member department page.
